{{Quote|They have Podracing on Malastare. Very fast, very dangerous.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Podracing''' was a popular sport in the less-developed regions of the galaxy and was one of the most dangerous sports ever invented. [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Racers]] [[Death/Legends|losing their lives]] during competitions was commonplace.

[[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]] were small, one-man [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorcraft]], composed of an anti-gravity pod propelled by one or more pairs of large [[Turbofan/Legends|turbine engines]]. The engines were not physically connected to each other, being linked instead by power couplings consisting of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] discharges. The engines were connected to the pods themselves by means of long, [[Steelton/Legends|Steelton]] cables. Podracers were custom-built, and were only as safe as the mechanic and pilot made them.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Hey, I don't care what universe you're from. That's gotta hurt!|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]|<ref name="Episode 1" />}}
[[File:AnakinPodracer-NEGVV.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's Podracer]]]]

Besides housing the racer's pilot, each pod contained a repulsorlift engine that kept the craft at a specific, low-level altitude. The turbine engines were incredibly powerful, and were connected by an [[Energy binder/Legends|energy binder]] that kept them from flying apart. Podracing was popularized in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its underground nature, great excitement, and almost gladiatorial propensity for carnage held immense appeal to all manner of folk living on the fringes of society.

Because of the reflexes needed to control the pod as it raced around the course at breakneck speeds, as well as the dexterity needed to control the Podracer, human Podracers were uncommon on Tatooine by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], apart from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], being dominated by non-humans. Inhuman physical attributes, as well as extra pairs of hands, came in handy when trying to control the pod at its top speed of around 900 km/h.

==History==
===Birth of the sport===
{{Quote|Podracers. You have to wonder whether they have half a brain left because they used to race, or they used to race because they had half a brain.|[[Ulda]], [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]|<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Boonta_Eve_Poster.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A poster advertising the Boonta Eve Classic race.]]
While the first race and racers are lost to history, Podracing traced its roots back to the days of animal-drawn carts<ref name="Card-CCG-Start Your Engines!">{{CCG|set=Tatooine Limited|cardname=Start Your Engines!}}</ref> on many different worlds. On [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], these cart races evolved to incorporate [[Hanno speeder/Legends|hanno speeders]]. These events were held by [[Boonta Hestilic Shad'ruu/Legends|Boonta the Hutt]] himself after his victory over the [[Parliament of Moralan]] and continued after his death.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Developing across the Outer Rim and developing at pace with that of galactic technology, various sports were reported to exist at multiple times in the history of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] being recognized as having produced some of the first engines for an early version of the sport.<ref name="EV" />

===Modern concept development===
The concept of modern day Podracing was born circa [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] by alien racer [[Gustab Wenbus/Legends|Gustab Wenbus]].<ref name="EV" /> Wenbus had entered himself in a race with a super-fast prototype pod designed by a mechanic named [[Phoebos/Legends|Phoebos]]. Standardizing the Podracer's configuration and promoting the first circuits, Wenbus' rules were simple: build a racer, make it fast, and race. Prizes usually consisted of parts or [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and were awarded to the first to cross the finish line or the last surviving racer.<ref name="EV" />

One of the most famous Podraces was the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], held on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The spectacular race was especially notable for being won by a [[Human/Legends|Human]], nine-year-old Anakin Skywalker. Other popular races at the time included the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] on Malastare, the [[Ando Overland]] on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]<ref name="sj">{{GamerCite|2|Snow Job}}</ref><ref name="hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}}</ref> and the [[Aleen Classic]].

Although technically illegal, but often controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]],<ref name="sj" /><ref name="hnn" /> Podracing flourished during the rule of the Galactic Republic, particularly among planets in the Outer Rim and on worlds such as Malastare and Ando Prime. With hundreds of thousands of circuits in operation on just as many worlds, Podracer pilots were often venerated athletes and were known for their swaggering, jockeying demeanor.<ref name="EV" /> The sport was also watched by citizens from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]; large [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreens]] in seedy establishments such as the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] relayed Podraces from all over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Podracing's popularity reached an all-time high following Skywalker's win, but as the political situation in the Republic deteriorated, so did the appeal of Podracing. Many of the sport's generally-accepted criminal activities were exposed, and some of the most famous racers were arrested for a variety of crimes. Podracing was soon outlawed in the Core. Shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was reported that attendance had dropped more than fifty percent from the era of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], although betting transactions remained at an all-time high.<ref name="hnn" />

===Imperial crackdown===
[[File:Podracing_poster.jpg|thumb|left|230px|A poster promoting Podracing.]]
With the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Podracing became outlawed across the galaxy, and under the Empire's far more stringent standards of law enforcement, the sport fell out of popularity altogether. The sponsorships, acclaim, and cash-flow that venues and racers received was brought to an abrupt end, and due to its largely non-Human appeal, racers disappeared or were arrested at a staggering rate. Imperial agents seized and auctioned off Podracers, the arenas, and all equipment they could locate, and within a few years of the Empire's rise, Podracing was effectively ended.<ref name="EV" />

Despite the Empire's best efforts, not all of the sport's racers or fans were destroyed. Racers that survived the initial purge went underground and the popularity of the sport was rekindled. Spreading to the fringes of the Outer Rim and creeping into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Territories]], races popped up over night and vanished just as quickly, avoiding Imperial intervention.<ref name="EV" /> During one race of the Boonta Eve Classic in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]-owned ''[[StarSpeeder 1000]]'' inadvertently got entangled in the race due to having recently escaped from being caught by the Empire at the Star Tours space station for having a Rebel spy onboard. It then briefly rode alongside the racers before flying back out of the planet's atmosphere and making contact with the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] for their next destination.<ref name="STAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

Broadcast in some entertainment venues like the [[Vapor Room]], a bar on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the fans of Podracing found ways to circumvent Imperial law. The racers themselves became even more cocky, seemingly invincible after repeatedly evading Imperial agents. New teams developed in the wake of the crackdown, and continued to thrive throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EV" />
